description: List the missed calls in your own Ringback call log for a time range: when, the caller's number, whether a text-back went out (and its delivery status) or why not (e.g. already texted recently, opted out, do-not-text), and the lead's status. Counts first, then up to 50 most recent calls. Needs a personal Ringback access token, created by the business owner in Ringback (Settings, AI assistants) and sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Read-only; reads only that business's own call and text log.

range.description: Time range: "today" (since midnight in the business's time zone), "7d", "30d" or "90d" (that many days back from now). Default "7d".

name: my_missed_calls
title: My missed calls (from my Ringback call log)
